mapper.select: SELECT h.people, h.seoul_pct, h.self_pct FROM crowd_cell c JOIN crowd_hour h USING (cell_id) WHERE ST_Contains(c.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)) AND h.day_kind = #{dayKind} AND h.hour = #{hour} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS place_id, ROUND(AVG(h.seoul_pct)) AS seoul_pct FROM retrip_place p JOIN crowd_cell c ON ST_Contains(c.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.longitude, p.latitude), 4326)) JOIN crowd_hour h ON h.cell_id = c.cell_id WHERE p.id IN #{placeId} AND h.day_kind IN #{dayKind} AND h.hour BETWEEN 10 AND 21 GROUP BY p.id
